result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with clear sections, consistent spacing, and readable typography. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image. A minor content redundancy also appears in that card's delivery info.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, making it look like the image failed to load or is stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image and card data have loaded, and add a fallback image or placeholder if loading fails.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows delivery information twice: a '€0 delivery' badge on the image and '€0 delivery' again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Remove one of the duplicate delivery labels, keeping the one in the metadata line or the image badge.
